facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of the financial district and the historical city center.
facts.excerpt: In the heart of the financial district and the historical city center

facts.text: The hotel has welcomed guests since 1876.
facts.excerpt: we have been welcoming guests in the tradition-steeped Steigenberger Icon Frankfurter Hof since 1876

facts.text: The Maintower, Römer and Paulskirche are only a few steps away.
facts.excerpt: The Maintower, Römer and Paulskirche are only a few steps away.

facts.text: The central station is approximately a 13-minute walk away.
facts.excerpt: The Central station can be reached in approx. a 13 minutes' walk.

facts.text: The hotel's address is Am Kaiserplatz in Frankfurt.
facts.excerpt:
Am Kaiserplatz
60311 Frankfurt

facts.text: Guests have free access to THE SPA.
facts.excerpt: Look forward to free access to the exclusive "The Spa"

facts.text: The spa is styled in the manner of '1001 Nights'.
facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to a time-out in the style of "1001 Nights" in our luxury hotel in Frankfurt.

facts.text: Studio Suites are two-room suites designed by Frankfurt interior designer Bergit Countess Douglas.
facts.excerpt: an elegant two-room suite, thoughtfully designed by renowned Frankfurt interior designer Bergit Countess Douglas

facts.text: Selected Studio Suites have a private terrace with views of the Frankfurt skyline.
facts.excerpt: Selected Studio Suites also feature a private terrace with impressive views of the Frankfurt skyline.

facts.text: The Royal Suite on the fourth floor has a living room with four French balconies, a private kitchen and a dedicated conference room.
facts.excerpt: a truly regal residence on the fourth floor. The Royal Suite features an expansive living room with four French balconies, a private kitchen, a dedicated conference room

facts.text: The Royal Suite's wellness bathroom has a Finnish sauna, a steam bath and a whirlpool bathtub.
facts.excerpt: a luxurious 30 m² wellness bathroom complete with a Finnish sauna, steam bath, and whirlpool bathtub

facts.text: Grand Deluxe Rooms have a marble bathroom with a walk-in rain shower and a bathtub with an integrated flat-screen TV.
facts.excerpt: An elegant marble bathroom featuring a walk-in rain shower and a bathtub with an integrated flat-screen TV

facts.text: Rooms include one complimentary minibar refill per stay.
facts.excerpt: one complimentary minibar refill per stay, a Nespresso coffee machine, and luxurious amenities create a refined retreat

facts.text: Restaurant Hofgarten serves breakfast, freshly prepared or as a buffet.
facts.excerpt: Start your day in our stylish Restaurant Hofgarten with a freshly prepared breakfast or our sumptuous buffet.

facts.text: Brasserie Moderne OSCAR's serves regional and contemporary menus and snacks.
facts.excerpt: In our Brasserie Moderne OSCAR's your palate will be spoiled with regional and contemporary presented menus and snacks.

facts.text: Facilities include the Autorenbar, the Ehrenhof terrace, the Cigarrum, a barber and a fitness area.
facts.excerpt: Autorenbar, Restaurant Hofgarten, Ehrenhof terrace, Cigarrum, THE SPA, barber, fitness area

facts.text: The hotel has 17 meeting rooms, from salons to a ballroom.
facts.excerpt: With 17 conference rooms, whether salon or ballroom

facts.text: Children under 6 stay free in their parents' room if no extra bed is required.
facts.excerpt: Children under 6 years stay free of charge in their parents' room if no extra bed is required.

facts.text: Pets are allowed on request for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Pets are allowed on request (for a fee).

facts.text: Parking is in a public parking garage or by valet, both chargeable.
facts.excerpt:
Public parking garage (chargeable).
Valet parking service (chargeable)

facts.text: 24-hour room service is available.
facts.excerpt: 24h room service

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a landmark that has shaped Frankfurt's city centre since 1876.
facts.excerpt: a landmark property that has shaped Frankfurt's city centre since 1876
